destructive SQL (DROP, TRUNCATE, DELETE without WHERE) against any database, local and development included
environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: None configured — this is the global layer; no employer or client org context belongs here
**Cloud provider(s)**: None configured
**Repository visibility**: Not asserted globally — each project declares its own. Assume private unless that project's settings say otherwise
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary

**Secrets management**: None configured. Treat these as sensitive files wherever they appear: .env and .env.* (excluding .env.example), config/credentials.yml.enc, config/master.key, .kamal/secrets, *.pem, *.key

**Default / protected branches**: main and master are protected — the PreToolUse hook block-edits-on-main.py refuses Edit/Write there inside ~/Projects and this config repo's checkout (docs/ exempt, except docs/ai-profile.md). Symlinks are resolved, so the live ~/.claude config is protected too. Bash writes are detected after the turn by uncommitted-on-main.py (Stop hook). Work belongs on a branch in a worktree
**CI/CD deploy targets**: None configured
**Network posture**: None configured
**Host containment**: None configured — assume Claude Code runs on an ordinary developer machine with open internet
**Source control**: No repository is trusted globally — each project declares its own trusted repo and origin remote
**Trusted internal domains**: None configured
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured
**Key internal services**: None configured
**Internal package registry**: None configured
**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: the secret-file patterns listed above — credentials, share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development on personal projects
**Org-specific CLIs**: None configured

**Worktree convention**: work happens in git worktrees at ~/worktrees/<repo>/<branch>, created by the WorktreeCreate hook. A worktree is exactly as trusted as the repository it belongs to, and no more
